judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Skills Objectives (same statement grain) with resolved Grade coordinates P1 (rank 0) and P2 (rank 1), so any developmental direction runs lower-to-higher, i.e. first_to_second. The P1 objective asks pupils to compare quantities of concrete objects to show which has less and which has more (P1 Unit 5, Whole Numbers 0-50); the P2 objective asks pupils to compare 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8 using the symbols <, > and = (P2 Unit 4, Fractions).
